response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM telescope_counts), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
